apps.name: Mend
apps.tagline: A local-first, 90-day no-contact companion that doesn't shame you for slipping.
apps.detail: Most breakup apps run on toxic positivity or streaks that reset to zero. Mend keeps every entry on-device — no account, no sync, no one watching — and treats a slip as data rather than failure.

apps.name: Job Tracker Util
apps.tagline: Track a job search without it becoming a second job.
apps.detail: Add a role in seconds, update its status when something moves, and get on with your day. Every application stays on the device — no sign-in, no server, no syncing your career data to somebody's cloud.

apps.name: Daily Memory Test
apps.tagline: Two-minute memory exercises for people living with dementia, and the people caring for them.
apps.detail: Short, calm, and encouraging by design — no timers, no scores to lose. Built to be finished alone or alongside a caregiver, and to feel good to complete rather than clinical.

apps.name: Canada Citizen Test
apps.tagline: Bilingual practice for the Canadian citizenship test.
apps.detail: Fully bilingual in English and Chinese so the concepts land, not just the vocabulary. Built for immigrants preparing for the exam without paying for a prep course.

apps.name: Australian Citizen Test
apps.tagline: Bilingual practice for the Australian citizenship test.
apps.detail: The same bilingual approach applied to Australia's exam — multiple-choice practice over the official material, in English and Chinese.

apps.name: Life in UK Quiz
apps.tagline: Study companion for the Life in the UK citizenship and settlement test.
apps.detail: Covers the official Life in the UK handbook, with question banks in English, Chinese, and Hindi for people sitting the British citizenship or settlement exam.

apps.name: CCSE Quiz
apps.tagline: Mock exams for the Spanish CCSE nationality test, with every answer explained.
apps.detail: Realistic simulations plus a written explanation for each answer, so a wrong pick teaches something. Trilingual interface — Spanish, English, and Chinese.

apps.name: TCF / TEF Practice Tests
apps.tagline: French proficiency drills for the TCF and TEF exams. No signup.
apps.detail: Aimed at people sitting the Test de Connaissance du Français or Test d'Évaluation de Français for Canadian or French immigration, university admission, or their own goals.

apps.name: CPA Exam Quiz
apps.tagline: Under-two-minute daily drills across every CPA exam section.
apps.detail: Short enough to finish on a commute, covering AUD, BEC, and the rest of the exam areas — built for people studying around a full-time job.
